mechanism: The watcher never writes /boot itself; it only launches limine-snapper-sync children: (a) one initial sync when /.snapshots is missing, (b) an inotifywait create/delete monitor loop spawning --add/--debounce syncs.

mechanism_evidence.quote: echo $"Directory $WATCH_DIR does not exist. limine-snapper-sync is triggered to initialize a snapper config for $WATCH_DIR."
inotifywait -q -m -e create -e delete --format '%e|%f' "${WATCH_DIR}" | while IFS='|' read -r event snapID; do

why_dormant.cause: inotifywait not installed: watcher exits 0 before entering the monitor loop at every in-window start

evidence.quote: info_msg $"inotifywait is not installed. Falling back to Snapper plugin integration."

evidence.fact: logged at all six in-window watcher instances (PIDs 1372, 1386, 1394, 1392, 10021, 1385)
evidence.quote: 2026-10-19T08:11:47-03:00 plazir27 limine-snapper-watcher[1372]: inotifywait is not installed. Falling back to Snapper plugin integration.

evidence.fact: loop-only cleanup-lock skip never reached; no [EVENT]/[SKIP] journal line in any capture
evidence.quote: info_msg $"[SKIP] Cleanup lock is active, skipping sync"

why_dormant.cause: the watcher's only other /boot-capable path, the initial-sync child, failed before any /boot write; after the config was created manually the branch no longer triggers

evidence.quote: 2026-10-19T22:48:23-03:00 plazir27 limine-snapper-watcher[1386]: Directory /.snapshots does not exist. limine-snapper-sync is triggered to initialize a snapper config for /.snapshots.
Btrfs.cc(createConfig):139 create subvolume failed, btrfs_util_create_subvolume_fd() failed, errno:13 (Permission denied)
Failed: "snapper --no-dbus -c root create-config /" with exit code: 1

evidence.fact: operator created the root config manually; /.snapshots exists thereafter and later watcher starts log no initial-sync line
evidence.quote: 2026-10-20T09:03:02-03:00 plazir27 sudo[5733]:    vgpnk : USER=root ; COMMAND=/usr/bin/snapper -c root create-config /

why_dormant.cause: unit attribution: all 10 in-window 'Updated: /boot/limine.conf' journal rows carry _SYSTEMD_UNIT snapper-cleanup.service (8) or limine-snapper-add-1-5846/limine-snapper-add-2-260668.service (2); none carries limine-snapper-sync.service, which a watcher-spawned child would inherit

rejected.claim: sync[5929]/sync[260715] Copied/Saved/Updated /boot lines are watcher activity
rejected.verdict: rejected: their _SYSTEMD_UNIT is limine-snapper-add-1-5846.service / limine-snapper-add-2-260668.service (snapper plugin systemd-run units), not limine-snapper-sync.service

unknowns.fact: why a second watcher instance (PID 10021) started mid-boot at 2026-10-20T09:10:54; Restart=on-failure does not restart an exit-0 watcher and no captured line shows a restart/enable trigger

activation_conditions.condition: install inotify-tools (provides inotifywait): the r19b:1365 check passes, the watcher stays resident in the monitor loop, and each /.snapshots create/delete spawns a limine-snapper-sync --add/--debounce child that writes /boot (suppressed only while /run/limine-snapper-cleanup.lock exists)

remove /.snapshots again: the initial-sync branch fires at every service start and, with the root snapper config now present, the spawned sync would proceed past the point where it previously failed and write /boot

notes: Upstream changelog corroborates the fallback as designed behavior: 'inotifywait' fallback now shows an info message instead of a warning when Snapper plugin integration is active. (host-capture-r19b.txt:989)
Watcher's other startup work touches only /tmp and the pacman lock, never /boot (host-capture-r19b.txt:1357, copy_config_if_needed).
